name: surveyjs
description: Build with every SurveyJS product: survey JSON authoring, Form Library integration in React/Angular/Vue/vanilla JS, Survey Creator customization, Dashboard response analytics, PDF export with survey-pdf, and AI extraction of responses from scanned paper forms.

interface.longDescription: Create SurveyJS form JSON, integrate the Form Library with web frameworks, customize Survey Creator, visualize responses with Dashboard, export forms and responses to PDF, and extract responses from scanned paper forms — all using current SurveyJS APIs.
defaultPrompt: Create a SurveyJS form from my requirements.
Integrate SurveyJS into my web application.
Customize Survey Creator for my application.
Visualize my survey responses with SurveyJS Dashboard.
Export my SurveyJS form and responses to PDF.
Extract responses from scanned paper forms with AI.
